records.part: OASIS system core upgrade from physical infrastructure to cloud-based solution (WiPSN)
records.reason: This project was accomplished at zero-cost to the County, while operating within existing Motorola contracts. All new hardware, resulting in a full refresh of the older OASIS system core, has been provided by Motorola.

records.part: Full replacement of OASIS Microwave Backhaul Network, redesigning microwave antenna pathways
records.reason: Utilizing $3.6 million of American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) funding, the Radio Division was able to fully replace the previous OASIS Microwave Backhaul Network.

records.part: Replacement radios for Milwaukee County Sheriff's Office (MCSO), funded in part through the APX 7000 radio replacement capital project
records.reason: These radios have been replaced with next generation radios from Motorola, which brings with them a host of new features to greatly improve first responder communications.
